Annieville homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Annieville, September 2026. Detached houses: 50 listed at month end and 5 sold in September, a sales ratio of 10% (a buyers’ market). Condos and townhomes: 13 listed at month end and 2 sold in September, a sales ratio of 15% (a balanced market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 17 sold over 4 months against an average of 54.5 listed, about 12.8 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was July with 7 sold. Condos and townhomes: 7 sold over 4 months against an average of 16.0 listed, about 9.1 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 3 sold.
